welcome1.message: Welcome to the WARS TCG in DragnCards 2.0! You can build a custom deck under 'Builder' or load a pre-built from 'Menu -> Load. To start a game - Search your Reserve for a site card and put it in play. Roll or flip to see who goes first. Draw 8 cards (Hotkey S). TAB Key displays hotkeys. Visit https://warstcg.org for more information, and online rules.
